component.name: Raptor
component.summary: Source port of Raptor: Call Of The Shadows

description.p: Raptor is a reversed-engineered SDL2 source port of the classic 1994 vertical shooter Raptor: Call Of The Shadows. This fork adds local same-screen co-op and is based on the skynettx SDL2 port.

Original game assets are not bundled for licensing reasons. On first launch without data, you can download the shareware GLB files from DOS Games Archive (with confirmation), open the download page in a browser, or install FILE0000.GLB and FILE0001.GLB yourself into: ~/.var/app/io.github.erpel_dev.Raptor/data/Raptor/
